statement: For every mixed-characteristic DVR A the explicit quadratic-transform union S has theta isomorphic in all degrees but is noncoherent at its positive-characteristic closed point
depends_on: C:regular_noetherian; C:filtered_colimits; explicit principal-ideal intersection and Nakayama
notes: Boundary on necessity only; the positive family was already covered by filtered-colimit continuity. Does not decide necessity within coherent rings.
